name: trip-planner-performance-tests
description: Performance tests for the Trip Planner API (Artillery)

scripts.test: npm run test:register && npm run test:login && npm run test:trips && npm run test:items
scripts.test:register: cross-env ARTILLERY_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 artillery run scenarios/register.yml --output reports/register.json
scripts.test:login: cross-env ARTILLERY_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 artillery run scenarios/login.yml --output reports/login.json
scripts.test:trips: cross-env ARTILLERY_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 artillery run scenarios/trips.yml --output reports/trips.json
scripts.test:items: cross-env ARTILLERY_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 artillery run scenarios/items.yml --output reports/items.json
